44.48169,-73.21971: Chief grey lock Abenaki legend holds that odzihozo, the creator of the champlain valley, turned himself into a rock island, which can be seen through the bandshell window to your left, so that he might view the valley forever. This statue honors chief grey lock and all indians indigenous to vermont. Dedicated July 22, 1984, it is the 47th of 50 state statues donated by sculptor Peter Wolf Toth to heighten the nation's appreciation for it s native-american citizens. Materials donated by Burlington Parks and Recreation department. Plaque donated by Chittenden County Historical Society
